**Balaji Amines Limited** is a premier, globally recognized chemical manufacturing enterprise headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1988, the company has grown exponentially over the decades to become one of India’s leading and most diversified manufacturers of Aliphatic Amines, Specialty Chemicals, and their derivatives. With a steadfast commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable manufacturing, Balaji Amines has carved out a distinct niche for itself within the highly competitive global chemical industry.

At its core, the company specializes in the production of Methylamines, Ethylamines, and an extensive portfolio of downstream amine derivatives. These highly specialized chemical compounds serve as vital raw materials and active intermediates across a broad spectrum of fundamental industries. The pharmaceutical and agrochemical sectors represent two of the largest consumers of their products, relying heavily on Balaji Amines for high-purity ingredients. Furthermore, their diverse product line is essential in the manufacturing of rubber chemicals, water treatment solutions, animal feeds, dye intermediates, and oil refinery applications.

Operating from state-of-the-art, ISO-certified manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra and Telangana, Balaji Amines leverages cutting-edge technology alongside highly robust Research and Development (R&D) capabilities. This allows the company to continuously optimize its production processes, pioneer import-substitute products for the Indian market, and expand its footprint internationally. Notably, Balaji Amines holds the distinction of being an extensively integrated chemical company, uniquely positioned to utilize its base products to manufacture high-margin, value-added specialty derivatives. 

Through a combination of strategic foresight, stringent quality control, and a deeply customer-centric approach, Balaji Amines Limited has transcended its regional roots in Solapur to establish a formidable global presence, exporting its high-grade chemical solutions worldwide while driving the steady growth of the Indian chemical sector.
